_comment: D0015 sets a blocking 70% mutation score. `vitest.related: false` is REQUIRED: it defaults to true, so Stryker runs `vitest --related <mutated file>` and discovers zero tests because nothing imports the package entries - that was BG-01M0J70K. `plugins` is explicit because pnpm's non-flat node_modules defeats Stryker's auto-discovery. NOTE: `since` was removed - it is not a Stryker option (the schema has no such key and Stryker warns 'Unknown stryker config option'), so D0015's changed-file scope was never in force; use `ignorePatterns`/`incremental` instead. The SCORE is still not meaningful while both packages export `export {}`.
